evolutionTreeCreate.title: Evolution Tree: Create
evolutionTreeCreate.instructions: Build your own digivolution line: start with an In-TrainingⅠ and add branches stage by stage (In-TrainingⅡ, Rookie, Armor/Champion/Ultimate/Hybrid, and finally Mega). You can add several branches at each step, and Unknown or Xros Wars digimon can be added at any stage. Armor can't evolve any further.
evolutionTreeCreate.confirmReset: Start over? The current tree will be lost.
evolutionTreeCreate.resultsTruncated: Showing the first {count} results, refine your search to see more.
